github.description: PaletteBoard: save, organize, and share image collections as color-themed mood boards. Change++ Fall 2026 Coding Challenge.

projects.title: PaletteBoard
projects.summary: Save photos into colourful mood boards. Every board builds its own colour palette and the whole app takes on its colours.
projects.problem:
Image-saving apps treat a collection as a plain list. Designers and hobbyists collect images for their **mood and colour**, but have no way to see, search or reuse the palette a collection creates.

PaletteBoard reads the main colours of every saved photo and blends them into a palette per board, then builds the experience around it: tinted board pages, colour search and palette export.
highlights: Each board's page is tinted with its own palette, with every accent contrast-checked for readability
Search by text, voice, or photo; browse by 13 colours
A 'Picked for you' feed that learns from what you save
Share boards by read-only link or invite editors and viewers
Google sign-in, installable on Android and iOS
Built with a spec-driven workflow (Spec Kit) and Claude Code

github.description: This business assistant essentially transforms raw business data into actionable insights through AI-powered analysis, interactive visualizations, and natural language querying, making it a comprehensive tool for data-driven business decision making.
github.readmeExcerpt:
# Business Analytics Assistant

An AI-powered business analytics platform that combines data analysis, visualization, and natural language processing to provide intelligent business insights.

## Features

- **AI-Powered Analysis**: GPT-4 Turbo integration for intelligent data interpretation
- **Multi-Format Data Support**: Upload CSV, Excel, and Markdown table files
- **Interactive Visualizations**: Dynamic charts and graphs using Plotly
- **Natural Language Queries**: Ask questions in plain English about your data
- **Real-time Processing**: Live data analysis with WebSocket support
- **Vector Database**: FAISS-powered semantic search for contextual understanding

## Technology Stack

- **Backend**: Flask with SocketIO, Pandas & NumPy, OpenAI API, LangChain, FAISS
- **Frontend**: Angular 17 analytics dashboard, React chat interface, Plotly.js

projects.title: AI Business Assistant
projects.summary: Upload business data and ask questions in plain English. AI analysis, interactive charts and semantic search turn it into insights.
projects.problem:
Small teams sit on spreadsheets of sales and pricing data but lack an analyst to interpret them. Asking a question of the data usually means writing formulas or code.

This assistant accepts CSV, Excel or Markdown tables and lets people **ask questions in natural language**, answering with AI-generated analysis and interactive visualisations.
highlights: Natural-language questions over uploaded CSV, Excel and Markdown data
GPT-4 Turbo analysis with LangChain orchestration
FAISS vector search for context-aware answers
Interactive Plotly charts in an Angular dashboard plus a React chat UI

github.readmeExcerpt:
# Campus Connect

A cross-platform mobile app built with Expo and React Native.

## Project structure

- `app/` – main application code (screens, navigation)
- `components/` – reusable UI components
- `constants/` – app-wide constants (colours, etc.)
- `store/` – Zustand state management stores
- `assets/` – images and static assets

Runs on iOS and Android through Expo Go.

projects.title: Campus Connect
projects.summary: A cross-platform mobile app for campus life, built with Expo, React Native and TypeScript.
highlights: Runs on iOS and Android from one TypeScript codebase via Expo
File-based screen navigation and reusable component library
